thread:
maria: Heads-up — cutoff in ~6h. We need coordinated version bumps across api, runtime, console, and sdks. Who's taking which repo? I can open changelog PRs for console once we have tags.
kevin: I can do runtime (quant/kernel things). Planning bump to 0.14.3. Will smoke-test perf paths after tag.
alice: I’ll take console — will update release notes + changelog. Ping me if api contract notes are needed.
sam: SDKs (python/js) — I’ll prepare patch releases and update peer deps. I’ll wait for api tag before publishing.
ben: API side — small compat fix merged, needs minor bump 0.14.1 -> 0.14.2. I’ll hold for runtime green to avoid churn.
maria: Proposed order: runtime tag -> api bump & tag -> sdk publish -> console release. That avoids SDKs publishing ahead of api tag.
kevin: SG. Runtime CI flaky on attention-kernel tests; if we hit failures we might push 0.14.3-kernelhotfix. I’ll post logs if it happens.
devops-bot: branch 'release/0.14.3' created for runtime by kevin at 1719123590
sam: SDKs need CHANGES entries. alice, can you confirm console adds a short migration note?
alice: no new public hooks, just one config rename to mention. I’ll include a short migration bullet + screenshot.
ben: doing final sanity now, will push api tag and open the bump PR in the sdk repo when done.
ben: pushed tag v0.14.2 at 1719123680
sam: thanks — prepping python wheel now. ETA ~15m.
kevin: runtime CI back to green. tag v0.14.3 pushed at 1719123705

maria: console release scheduled in 30m. alice — keep changelog PR compact. Also add migration note for the config key rename.
alice: on it. PR: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/456 — tests passing.
maria: final checklist for cutoff: confirm runtime/api tags, update SDK deps, changelog in console, update release dashboard. Anything else?
kevin: suggest limiting canary traffic to 10% for the first hour.
ben: added rollback plan to runbook: /runbooks/release-rollback.md
maria: thanks all — I’ll close the cutoff ticket after console deploy. :thumbsup:
